name: Feature
about: A new command, movie.toml field, player feature or engine capability
labels: enhancement

<!-- New shader code (functions, transitions, effects) belongs in shotglass-kit, not
     the engine: https://github.com/antonmarsden/shotglass-kit/issues
     The engine provides a contract (uniforms, entry points, the transition interface,
     cue defines), not looks. -->

**What and why** (what you want to make, and what's in the way today)


**Proposal** (commands, `movie.toml` fields, UI; an example film snippet helps)


**Engine contract** (does it add or change uniforms, entry points, the transition interface or cue defines? Those are semver API)


**Invariants it might touch** (see CLAUDE.md: blocking, GPU syncs, the audio callback, deterministic frames and sound)


**Done when**
- [ ] 
- [ ] Tested (unit test, selftest check or golden case) and documented in README.md / docs/
